description: Defines the QuicHeaderList class, which accumulates HTTP header pairs for QUIC protocol implementation, including methods for handling header blocks and internal data management.

classes.name: QuicHeaderList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of HTTP headers for QUIC, supporting header accumulation, size management, and interface implementation.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header block.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a header block, updating byte counts.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representation of the header list.
